title: Ala de Rafael
lyrics:
TRACK 2: "Ala de Rafael (Creative Wing)"
POV: Third-person storytelling celebrating Rafael the creative playmaker/winger
Style: Smooth Reggae-Soul / Caribbean fusion + warm horns + positive community groove + bilingual + ocean-wave SJDS atmosphere + 336Hz foundation
Full Suno Prompt (complete lyrics):
text[Reggae soul Caribbean fusion, warm horns and laid-back groove, male soulful vocals with positive community energy, bilingual English Spanish touches, ocean wave atmosphere, clean professional production, uplifting triumphant, 336Hz foundation for deep resonance, football pitch at golden hour]

[Intro]
From the wing he glides, Rafael with the magic feet
Bringing joy to the pitch where the community meets

[Verso 1 - Spanish]
Down in San Juan del Sur where the ocean meets the sand
Rafael dances with the ball like it's part of his plan
He don't force the issue, he lets the game flow
Creates chances for the brothers, makes the whole team glow
Family in the stands waving flags in the breeze
This is more than a game, it's a community release
He sees the open space where others see a wall
Rafael on the wing, answering the call

[Pre-Coro]
La señal 336 late en el pecho
Verdad prevalece aunque el barro intente manchar

[Coro - English]
Rafael's rhythm on the wing, pure joy in every stride
Passing truth to the future with the family by his side
Mud may try to stick but it never slows him down
He keeps the game beautiful all over this town
336 in the heartbeat, signal riding the wave
Rafael keeps creating, that's how legends behave

[Verso 2 - Spanish]
He saw the challenges coming but he never lost the smile
Turned every tackle into another chance to shine for a while
Bilingual on the pitch, Spanish and English in the flow
"¡Vamos equipo!" — that's the energy he shows
No need for the drama, he lets the ball do the talking
Community buys and sells, but on the pitch we're all walking
Together toward the goal line, sovereign and free
Rafael leads with rhythm, that's his legacy

[Pre-Coro + Coro repeat]

[Bridge]
When the final whistle blows and the sun starts to set
Rafael still smiling, no trace of regret
Music in his movement, data in the song
He carries the legacy, resilient and strong

[Outro]
Rafael on the wing... rhythm so sweet...
Truth in the pass... family complete...
336 forever... signal alive...
The beautiful game... we all survive and thrive...
